overview.title: Family care handover
overview.notice: Choose a family explicitly. This shows only shared baby-care records from the last 7 days. Missing or unshared records are unknown; they do not mean nothing happened.
overview.note: What the next caregiver should know
overview.share: Show my saved note to members of this family
overview.noteNotice: Sharing starts off. Include only what is needed for baby care. Notes are shown for 7 days after saving. Membership or sharing changes hide a note until you review and save again. Notes are not sent to AI or the institution.
overview.loadError: Could not retrieve current family information. Check your connection and membership.
overview.saveError: The save result is unconfirmed. Your input remains on screen. Reload to check the saved note.
overview.conflictError: Membership settings or the note changed elsewhere. Your input remains on screen. Review current information.
overview.reloadConfirm: Discard your unsaved note and load current information?
overview.deleteConfirm: Empty this note? Save changes to clear the saved note too.
overview.unsaved: Changes to this note are not saved.
overview.reload: Review current note and sharing settings

journey.title: My help progress
journey.notice: Only you can see this progress. Calling or opening a booking link does not change it. This does not send a request, make a booking or deliver a reminder.
journey.timeNotice: This time is for your reference. No notification will be sent.
journey.failed: The save result is unconfirmed. Your input remains on screen. Reload to check current information.
journey.conflict: Progress changed on another screen. Your input remains on screen. Reload to review current information.
journey.invalidTime: Enter a valid date and time.
journey.reloadConfirm: Discard unsaved progress for this contact and load current information?
journey.loadError: Could not load your help progress. Please reload.
journey.archived: Progress for contacts no longer listed
journey.archivedNotice: Your previous progress remains available. Check another contact for current service information.
journey.archivedDraftNotice: Unsaved input from before this contact was removed also remains on this screen. If you have never saved progress for this contact, you cannot create it after removal. Closing the screen loses unsaved input.
journey.discardDraft: Discard unsaved input for this contact
journey.discardConfirm: Discard only the unsaved input for this contact? Saved progress will remain.

invitation.title: Invite family with a link or QR code
invitation.notice: The link works once within 24 hours. Anyone holding it can join, so give it only to your intended invitee. Creating a new link revokes your unused links. Changes to the inviter's sharing settings or membership also invalidate it.
invitation.failed: The result is unconfirmed. Reload to check. If a link was not returned, you can create a new one.
invitation.unavailable: Could not verify the invitation. Check your connection; it may have expired, been used or been revoked. Ask for a new link if needed.
invitation.confirmNotice: You join only when you choose the button below. Joining does not share your records. Choose what to share after joining.

connection.title: Connection and save status
connection.offline: This device reports no network connection. Saving records and requests needs a connection.
connection.restored: The device connection is back. For an unconfirmed save, check the list before retrying the same operation.
connection.noOfflineStorage: Offline saving is not available. Unsent input may be lost if you close the screen. Input is not automatically stored on this device or resent.
connection.offlineSave: Not sent: there is no connection. Your input remains on this screen. Retry the same save after reconnecting.
connection.unconfirmedSave: Save result unconfirmed. It may already be saved. Check the list or retry the same save. Do not recreate it as a new record.
connection.unconfirmedAction: The result is unconfirmed. Processing may have succeeded. Your input remains available. Reload to check what is saved.
connection.legacyNotice: Data left by an older version is never automatically resent. You can clear this device's old unsent data and credentials stored with it. This does not delete your current server records or drafts. Sign-out also attempts this cleanup.
connection.legacyClearConfirm: Permanently clear this device's old unsent data, including any belonging to another account? Server records are unaffected.
connection.blocked: Cleanup completion is unconfirmed. Close other tabs and retry, or check the browser's site-data settings.

directory.paused: This service is temporarily paused. Check the alternative contact.
directory.fallback_contact: Who to contact if unavailable or paused
directory.noMatches: No contacts match this maintainer. The selected contact's edits remain available.
directory.stale: Could not refresh local information. Previously retrieved information remains visible. Check the source for current availability. Your help-progress input remains on screen.
directory.changes: Changes from the current public information
directory.noChanges: This matches the current public information.

ai.excerptNotice: This is an excerpt from the AI answer. Read the full answer for conditions and cautions.
ai.provided: Information you provided for this question
ai.providedNotice: Your question and the profile or previous exchange you chose to send. These, including the previous AI answer, are not medically verified facts.
ai.noQuestions: No further questions were extracted. This does not mean all necessary information is available.
ai.questionsNotice: These are questions extracted from the AI answer. You do not have to add information you prefer to keep private.
ai.noSources: No retrieved document with a displayable source link was available for this answer.
ai.sourcesNotice: These links identify retrieved documents. They do not verify every claim or indicate professional review. URLs written by the model are not added here.
ai.prepareQuestion: Prepare a question for human support
ai.questionDraft: Question for your consultation sheet (up to 250 characters)
ai.questionNotice: Edit your original question. After confirmation, choose a question slot on the consultation sheet. Nothing is sent or shared automatically.
ai.replaceQuestion: Replace your consultation question draft with a question from another answer?

walkthrough.saved: Showing an example record. No real record has been saved.
walkthrough.where: Real records appear in Home's recent records and in Records. Open Records to correct or delete them.
walkthrough.corrected: The example changed. No personal record was saved and nothing was sent to AI.

account.manualNotice: This is a manual small-pilot workflow. This screen does not reset passwords or erase data. Perform actual work through your controlled procedure, then attest the steps and outcome here.
account.verified: Identity verified through a controlled procedure
account.privateReferenceNotice: Enter procedure references only. Do not enter identity documents, passwords, reset codes or health information.

steps.recovery_executed: Account recovery performed through a secure procedure
steps.delivery_confirmed: Recovery instructions delivered to the verified person
steps.family_access_revoked: Family membership and sharing access revoked
steps.retention_explained: Remaining copies and backup retention explained

account.nextAction: Your next action and the operator's next step
account.outcome: Processing performed and result (shown to the person)
account.retained: Deletion scope, remaining copies and retention
account.receiptMethod: This result was registered after the operator confirmed manual processing. It does not indicate an automatic reset or erasure by the app.
account.pendingNextAction: Please wait for the operator's instructions.
account.finalNextAction: Review the outcome and reply. Use the published contact details to check any further action.
account.noReplyTime: The operator has not entered an expected response time. You can also check using the published contact details.
account.incomplete: Check identity verification, completed steps, procedure references and outcome. Open requests also need a next action and response time; deletion completion needs a remaining-copy explanation.
account.conflict: This request changed elsewhere or its result is finalized. Your unsaved input remains available. Review current information.
